# Shaahi Biryani

> Zabihah Halal Hyderabadi, Indian & Pakistani restaurant in Plano, TX, specializing in slow-cooked goat dum biryani, haleem, and halal catering (50 to 3,000+ guests) for weddings, walimas and corporate events across the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. 100% Zabihah Halal, Hafsah Certified, HMS Certified.

Address: 3421 E Renner Rd, Suite 110, Plano, TX 75074. Phone: (469) 960-3300.
Hours: Sun & Tue–Thu 11:30am–10:00pm, Fri–Sat 11:30am–11:00pm, closed Mondays.
Founded 2017 in Glendale Heights, IL; Plano, TX location opened April 6, 2025.

## Core pages

- [Home, full menu & online ordering](https://shaahibiryanidfw.com/): Menu, hours, location, online ordering for pickup
- [Catering](https://shaahibiryanidfw.com/#catering): Wedding, walima, corporate and event catering, 50 to 3,000+ guests
- [Private event hall](https://shaahibiryanidfw.com/hall): On-site banquet hall, up to 132 guests
- [Venues we cater](https://shaahibiryanidfw.com/venues): Partner venues across DFW
- [Reserve a table](https://shaahibiryanidfw.com/reserve)
- [Careers](https://shaahibiryanidfw.com/careers)
- [Dine-in menu](https://shaahibiryanidfw.com/dine-in)
